headline: Sensex drops over 300 points as Nifty falls below 25,200 amid inflation concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on investor sentiment across benchmark indices.
The Indian rupee snapped its rising streak due to a hawkish Fed stance and rising crude oil prices.
Trade deficit widened as October imports touched record highs despite strong export growth.
Profit booking was observed in major financial, auto, and retail sector stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex closed 318 points lower, while Nifty 50 ended below the 25,200 mark.
Paytm shares surged to a record high following preliminary RBI approval for a wallet licence.
Natco Pharma reported a 60.8% decline in Q2 net profit to ₹202.6 crore.
Bajaj Auto emerged as the top recipient of auto PLI payouts in FY26 ahead of Tata Motors and Ola.
summary: Indian equities ended lower as Sensex fell over 300 points and Nifty slipped below 25,200, driven by inflation fears and macro pressures. Despite intraday recovery attempts supported by global cues, major indices finished in the red. Stock-specific action remained prominent with Paytm hitting record highs and earnings updates driving moves in Grasim and Natco Pharma.
